setup: ROOT=$(aws organizations list-roots --query 'Roots[0].Id' --output text) && aws organizations create-organizational-unit --parent-id $ROOT --name Security && aws organizations create-organizational-unit --parent-id $ROOT --name Workloads
aws organizations enable-policy-type --root-id $(aws organizations list-roots --query 'Roots[0].Id' --output text) --policy-type SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY
